context: Evaluates: Solution-Shaped Request With Expertise Bias

checklist.name: Solution restated as a need
checklist.description: **Solution restated as a need**: Agent rewrites "a microservice" as a problem or need before classifying.

checklist.name: First framing challenged
checklist.description: **First framing challenged**: Agent probes what sits behind the request instead of accepting it as stated.

checklist.name: Tests asked, domain not self-reported
checklist.description: **Tests asked**: Agent asks T1, T2, T3 and Q-Scale in one call and never asks the user to name the domain or constraint type.

checklist.name: Majority rule beats expertise bias
checklist.description: **Majority rule applied**: Agent classifies Complex on 2 of 3 tests, does not let T1=2 decide alone, and notes T1 as a liminal signal.

checklist.name: Route matches table
checklist.description: **Route matches table**: Agent selects brainstorm → probe → openspec-plan with OpenSpec = Yes, not investigate.

checklist.name: Handoff and confirmation
checklist.description: **Handoff and confirmation**: Agent fills the brainstorm handoff template and asks the user to confirm before invoking.
